Counterpoint Research has released a new report exploring the impact of the iPhone Duo on the foldable smartphone market, display suppliers, and the growth of this sector through 2030. Here are the details.

Apple to capture 27% of foldable panel shipments in 2026

Counterpoint Research published a new report yesterday, outlining expectations for the iPhone Duo's performance through the end of 2026 that roughly align with those of TrendForce.

Counterpoint noted that, although the iPhone Duo will not officially go on sale until next month, Apple is still projected to account for 27% of foldable smartphone panel shipments in 2026.

As for Samsung, it is expected to remain firmly in first place with a 33% market share, with shipments growing 8% year-on-year. Huawei is forecast to rank third with a 25% market share, trailing Apple by just two percentage points, though its shipments are projected to decline 6%.

Looking further ahead, Counterpoint expects foldable panel shipments to grow 74% between 2026 and 2030, "equivalent to a compound annual growth rate of roughly 15% per year."

The report notes that "Apple's shipments are projected to grow 167% from the second half of 2026 base through 2030, lifting the brand's market share by approximately 15 percentage points to 42%"; Samsung's shipments are expected to grow 27%, but its market share will fall to 24%. For Huawei, shipments are forecast to rise just 3%, with market share slipping to 15%.
